source.label: Tekken 3 move and combo archive
source.note: Commands use 1/2/3/4 notation. Land the starting attack before continuing a route. Timing, range, opponent size and recovery matter; restrictions are listed beside each route. 10 hit combos are preset strings, not guaranteed juggles. Movelists and selected community routes are drawn from Tekken Wiki and the Tekken Zaibatsu Tekken 3 archive.
